name: Galaxy Surfactants Ltd
title: Galaxy Surfactants Ltd - 540935 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell to INR122 crore (INR20,114/t vs INR21,715/t) on AMET volumes down 15% and RoW down 7%; management guides only Q1 volume at 6–8% high end and EBITDA/t INR19,000–21,000.

utilisation.quote: the Egypt operations have got restored to a significantly superior level

capex.quote: I don't see any growth capex given what -- there may be some work in progress that will get capitalized

triggers.label: AMET volumes down 15% in Q4
triggers.quote: the AMET region remains challenging for reasons outlined earlier with volumes declining 15% year-on-year in Q4

triggers.label: EBITDA/t INR20,114 vs INR21,715
triggers.quote: EBITDA per metric ton for Q4 FY '26 at INR20,114 per metric ton versus INR21,715 per metric ton in Q4 FY '25

triggers.label: Q1 volume 6–8%, high end only
triggers.quote: we'll be delivering close to the higher end of the volume guidance range of 6% to 8%

triggers.label: Growth capex stopped, maintenance INR20–30 cr
triggers.quote: the capex that we do, we do have maintenance capex. But they're not more than INR20 crores, INR30 crores per year

guidance.value: close to higher end of 6% to 8%
guidance.quote: we'll be delivering close to the higher end of the volume guidance range of 6% to 8%

guidance.value: higher end of INR19,000 to INR21,000
guidance.quote: EBITDA as well at the higher end of the range of INR19,000 to INR21,000 metric tonne

red_flags.label: Raw-material availability (sulfur, ethylene oxide)
red_flags.quote: it is not a comfortable situation if you ask me that you can sleep every day

evasions.quote: I don't want to mislead because there's no way that I can -- because the way things are, I'm just looking at the quarter 1
we are not able to reveal, but it is enough to say that it's not material in FY '25, '26
